name: AppX Telegram Bot
description: AppX / Parmar Academy course downloader — Telegram bot that downloads encrypted video lectures

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID — get from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash — get from https://my.telegram.org

OWNER.description: Your Telegram numeric user ID (send /id to the bot after it starts)

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection string — free cluster at https://cloud.mongodb.com  e.g. mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/?retryWrites=true&w=majority

CREDIT.description: Display name shown in video captions (6–8 letters)

VIMEO_WORKER_URL.description: Cloudflare Worker URL for Vimeo signed URL extraction (optional)

cookies_file_path.description: Path to YouTube cookies file (default: youtube_cookies.txt)
